𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐱 — 𝐁𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐁𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐏𝐯𝐏 𝐢𝐧 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔!

𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐱..?

Retronix is a Minecraft: Pocket Edition (MCPE) server built for players who miss the golden age of PvP. Our goal is to bring back the excitement of classic PotPvP and HCT/HCF, creating a place where competition, skill, and the old-school PvP experience come first.

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐱?

PvP has changed a lot over the years, and we're here to bring that classic feeling back. With multi-version support, you can join from versions 1.12, 1.16, 1.18, 1.21, and 1.26.50, bringing different generations of MCPE players together in one place.

Whether you're looking to dominate in PotPvP, get back into HCT/HCF, or prove your skills against other players, Retronix is working toward one goal: making MCPE PvP great again in 2026.

The old days aren't gone. It's time to bring them back.

𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐱 — 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐜 𝐌𝐂𝐏𝐄 𝐏𝐯𝐏.
